entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She's so glamorous... Like an[n]enchantress.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ahaha... It's so weird to think a woman[n]like her could be born from my heart.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But after all we've been through, I can[n]definitely say that she's a part of me.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So you've accepted who you really are,[n]Ann-senpai?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: That's a beautiful thing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You've accepted your own self, too![n]That's basically the same.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Ann-senpai... Thank you so much!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Isn't Lady Ann just beautiful? Even her[n]Persona's a knockout. Don't you agree,[n]Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's... cool, I guess? She's got a cigar in[n]her mouth, steppin' on a guy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't get it, do you? That passion[n]is part of Lady Ann's unique charm!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, I guess if you're into that kinda thing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You know, your Persona is rather—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Stop! Just, stop right there! I don't want[n]to hear it!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're overreacting. What's the matter?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were about to say something rude,[n]weren't you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Like, "Your Persona is lacking in[n]elegance. I wonder where it gets[n]that from? Muahahahahaaa!"

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Is that really how you see me?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, this reminds me of Lady Ann's[n]elegant awakening.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What do you mean, "elegant"? I was at[n]the end of my rope there.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That desperation is what caused your[n]Persona to awaken. The sheer rage[n]you had was impressive!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're such a suck-up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But thanks. I like that about you,[n]Morgana.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do my ears deceive me? Did you just[n]say you're falling for me, Lady Ann...!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Nope!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Despite them both being pink, my[n]Persona is rather different from yours.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh, you're right.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess I'm not refined enough to have[n]a Persona like Milady...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, but yours is wonderful just the way[n]she is! You could even call her... Sexy[n]Cat Mask!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sexy... cat?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: How strange... I sense an unbreakable[n]connection between you and this statue.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? You can tell?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Just a feeling. Are you familiar with it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You could say that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess you really are me, Carmen.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: In fiction, Carmen is usually depicted as[n]a devilish woman, leading men on and[n]making them go wild...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: How about you? Any guys losing their[n]minds over you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? I mean, um...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ohh, what's this? Sounds like there's a[n]story in you! Could I have a moment of[n]your time?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: N-No! Don't get the wrong idea!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Simply exquisite...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Every Persona begins with the same[n]base idea, but emerges as a work of[n]art unique to that person's true nature.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: True nature, huh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, I've been wonderin'. Are those[n]whipped dudes a part of Ann's nature[n]too?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... I have been curious about that as[n]well. Tell us the truth, Ann.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The truth...? Ugh, stop asking such[n]creepy questions!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Between this and my Phantom Thieves[n]outfit, um... Is it too late to change[n]anything?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Like... How much skin they're showing?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can relate. Well, it's not necessarily[n]the skin itself, but...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's rather... How should I say this?[n]Tight-fitting.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, now...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think the two of you look quite cool.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you've got a killer bod in real life, you[n]get a killer bod for your Persona...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That is the harsh reality of our world.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't think of it like that. Lady Ann's[n]Persona is graciously representing the[n]alluring depths of her sexy passion!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What are you talking about? Get your[n]mind out of the gutter!
